units.source_text: 但是我想：你倘能体谅我长年效劳的忠诚，

en.t: But I thought that if you could understand the loyalty with which I have served you for so many years,

units.source_text: 就不会为了丧服的忌讳而像初次见面一般疏远我吧。

en.t: you would surely not keep me at a distance as though we had just met, merely because of the taboo of mourning dress.

units.source_text: 如此反而太拘泥了。”

en.t: To do so would be far too bound by formality.

units.source_text: 便从那天破晓残月之下听琴的情景开始，

en.t: He then began with the scene of that dawn, when he had heard the koto beneath the lingering moon,

units.source_text: 叙述多年来常为思慕大女公子而痛苦难忍的情状，说了一大篇话。

en.t: and spoke at length of how, for many years, his longing for the elder princess had often caused him unbearable pain.

units.source_text: 大女公子听了深感羞耻，心情甚是不快。

en.t: The elder princess listened and felt deeply ashamed, and her heart was greatly troubled.

units.source_text: 她反复思量：“他原来怀着这种心思，

en.t: She turned it over again and again in her mind, thinking, So he had been harboring such feelings all along,

units.source_text: 外表装得多么冷静而诚实啊！”

en.t: while outwardly appearing so calm and sincere.

units.source_text: 薰君把身旁的短帷屏拉过来，遮隔了佛像，暂时躺下身子。

en.t: Lord Kaoru drew a low curtain screen beside him closer, shielding the Buddhist image from view, and lay down for a while.

units.source_text: 佛前所供名香，气味非常馥郁。

en.t: The fine incense offered before the Buddha gave off an exceptionally rich fragrance.

units.source_text: 庭中芒草的香气也异常浓烈。

en.t: The scent of the pampas grass in the garden was unusually strong as well.

units.source_text: 此人道心深固，对佛比别人尊敬，在佛前不敢放肆。

en.t: His religious devotion was deep and firm, and because he revered the Buddha more than others did, he did not dare behave freely before the image.

units.source_text: 他想：“如今她在丧服之中，

en.t: He thought, She is now in mourning,

units.source_text: 我在此时同她缠扰，实属粗率无礼，而且违反了我的初心。

en.t: and for me to press myself upon her at such a time would be truly rash and discourteous, and would go against my original intention.

units.source_text: 应该等到丧满之后，那时她的心情多少总会软化起来吧。”

en.t: I should wait until her mourning is over; by then her feelings may soften somewhat.

units.source_text: 他终于遏制了热情，心境渐渐安静下来。

en.t: At last he restrained his passion, and his heart gradually grew calm.

units.source_text: 秋夜的情趣，即使不是这种地方，也自惹人哀思；

en.t: The mood of an autumn night naturally stirs melancholy even in places unlike this;

units.source_text: 何况在这山中，风声和篱间的虫声，都使人听了不胜凄凉之感。

en.t: how much more here in the mountains, where the sound of the wind and the insects among the hedges filled the listener with unbearable desolation.

units.source_text: 薰君谈论人世无常之事，大女公子有时也作对答，

en.t: Lord Kaoru spoke of the impermanence of human life, and the elder princess answered him from time to time,

units.source_text: 那姿态非常端详优美。

en.t: her manner was exceedingly composed and graceful.

units.source_text: 打瞌睡的侍女们推察两人已经结缘，

en.t: The drowsing ladies in waiting assumed that the two had already formed a bond,

units.source_text: 都走进自己的室中去睡觉了。

en.t: and all went into their own rooms to sleep.
